snapshot.banner.title: Snapshot — read-only
snapshot.banner.warn: Do not upload or publish it (not even as a Claude Artifact).
snapshot.info.title: About this snapshot
snapshot.info.body: This single file holds a fixed state of the project. It opens without internet or Python; you can read, filter, look at the figures and print, but not change anything. Whatever its author redacted is not in the file at all.
snapshot.cmd.title: This snapshot is read-only
snapshot.cmd.body: Nothing can be saved here: this file is a fixed state of the project. You can do the same on your own computer with this command:
snapshot.cmd.hint: Run the command in the metaanalizis-asszisztens folder. If it contains <projektmappa>, replace it with the path of the project folder.
snapshot.cmd.copied: The command was copied to the clipboard.
snapshot.readOnly: The snapshot is read-only; this action needs the live workbench.
snapshot.missing: This data is not in the snapshot.
snapshot.pdf: Files (PDF, SVG, CSV …) are not in the snapshot, only their reference: {doc}, page: {page}.
snapshot.kbSearch: In a snapshot only the KB items it refers to can be searched; full text is never included.
